name: Upgradeable Proxy Storage Collision
threat_model: A proxy administrator slot collides with implementation storage, allowing delegated implementation writes to corrupt proxy control state.
assumptions: The example uses delegatecall and a simplified proxy storage layout.
The attacker can invoke the vulnerable delegated behavior but has no privileged proxy role initially.
The test's storage collision is the demonstrated property; it does not validate an arbitrary proxy implementation.
invariant: Implementation storage writes cannot overwrite proxy administration state.

detector_expectations.expectation: the intended storage-layout collision is verified by the regression test
